children: Stellar will activate the Bell (Protocol 30) mainnet upgrade on 23 Nov 2026, updating the protocol used by its live network.

Bell brings smart accounts built for business use at scale. It also starts work on quantum-safe signatures and faster ledgers. For XLM holders, the main implication is stronger network capabilities for enterprise use, with smart accounts expanding the protocol's support for businesses.
Bell is designed to make smart accounts ready for businesses at scale and begin work on quantum-safe signatures and faster ledgers.
Learn more in the upgrade guide👇

title: Stellar: Bell (Protocol 30) upgrades the mainnet - 23 Nov 2026
